batches.brief:
Batch w2-b01, unit U2-invoices, branch migrate/billing/2-U2-invoices. Wave 2 of the OW_BILLING Oracle -> MongoDB Atlas migration (D-015).
SETUP (every batch)
- Repo github.com/Cognition-Partner-Workshops/otterworks. Branch off origin/migrate/billing/0-setup (it holds the .migration/ workspace, shared tools, spec, tolerances; PR #1741, not yet merged): `git fetch origin migrate/billing/0-setup && git checkout -b <your branch> origin/migrate/billing/0-setup`. Open ONE PR with base tp-run/mongodb-20260929T160602Z (never main or tech-partnerships). Until #1741 merges your diff also shows the setup commits; say so in the PR body.
- Do not edit anything under .migration/ (read it only). Do not merge. Do not touch services/admin-service (planted bug) or unrelated auth/notification-service files.
- Harness: /home/ubuntu/.venvs/recon/bin/recon (run `recon selftest`); python for loaders/tools: /home/ubuntu/.venvs/recon/bin/python. Canonicalization profile: the mongo-migration plugin's skills/mongo-migration/profiles/oracle.md (find it with `ls -d /opt/.devin/plugins/cache/*mongo-migration*/*/skills/mongo-migration/profiles/oracle.md`).
- Fixture (synthetic, manifest .migration/fixtures/oracle-mmpfix.manifest.json): `make oracle-billing-up && make oracle-billing-seed NS=mmpfix SCALE=demo` (Oracle Free on localhost:52521/FREEPDB1, user/password ow_billing/ow_billing, local only) and `docker run -d --name ow-tp-mongo-fixture -p 127.0.0.1:57017:27017 mongo:8.0.32`. Export OW_TP_ORACLE_FIXTURE_DSN='{"user":"ow_billing","password":"ow_billing","dsn":"localhost:52521/FREEPDB1"}' and OW_TP_MMP_FIXTURE_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:57017 (these are local fixture values, not secrets).
- Live: source secret OW_TP_ORACLE_RO_DSN (read-only, never write the source), target secret OW_TP_MMP_TARGET_URI, database ow_tp_mmp_live only. Secret names only; never print values. Source query concurrency 1. The org statement guard refuses dynamically built SQL: every Oracle statement is a string literal at its call site, schema-qualified ow_billing.<table>.
- Spec .migration/03_mapping_spec.json (map-1, STOP B D-011/D-015), tolerances .migration/02_tolerances.json v1 (exact at source scale, Decimal128 money, CHAR rstrip, ''=NULL=missing, UTC-naive ms dates, full row diff to 200,000).

UNIT
- Sources OW_BILLING.INVOICE_HEADER (18,750 live rows) and OW_BILLING.INVOICE_LINE (150,000). Spec collections `invoices` and `quarantine_invoice_line`; write targets exactly ow_tp_mmp_live.invoices and ow_tp_mmp_live.quarantine_invoice_line.
- invoices: one doc per INVOICE_HEADER row; matched INVOICE_LINE rows embedded in `lines`, keyed line_id, sorted by line_no then line_id (19,512 invoices repeat a line_no; max 23 lines).
- quarantine_invoice_line: the 37 lines whose INVOICE_ID has no header, every source column kept, _id = LINE_ID, plus the quarantine metadata fields the spec declares. Orphans are never dropped and never embedded.
STEPS
1. Loader: services/legacy-billing/migration/U2-invoices/load.py. Import the shared library from .migration/tools (sys.path insert of <repo>/.migration/tools, `import mongo_load`) and end with `mongo_load.run_unit("U2-invoices", load)`. Read headers and lines with two literal SELECTs; split lines into matched (embed) and orphan (quarantine) in Python. Use mongo_load.load_spec/coll_spec/fetch_dicts/build_root_docs/write_collection (idempotent replace + stale delete, enforces your wave-2 write targets). Pass `--evidence-dir docs/tech-partnerships/recon/U2-invoices` so load records land outside .migration/.
2. Fixture: run the loader `--mode fixture` twice (second run proves idempotency), then from the repo root:
   recon run --unit U2-invoices --family oracle --mapping .migration/03_mapping_spec.json --collections invoices,quarantine_invoice_line --tolerances .migration/02_tolerances.json --canonicalization <oracle.md> --mode fixture --target-class local --source-dsn-secret OW_TP_ORACLE_FIXTURE_DSN --target-uri-secret OW_TP_MMP_FIXTURE_URI --target-db ow_tp_mmp_live --allowed-targets-file .migration/allowed_targets.json --source-concurrency 1 --out docs/tech-partnerships/recon/U2-invoices/fixture/
   Fix loader code until PASS (max 3 full re-runs, then FAIL with a failure_class).
3. Live, once: loader `--mode live` twice (first + idempotent rerun), then the same recon command with --mode live --target-class migration_cluster --source-dsn-secret OW_TP_ORACLE_RO_DSN --target-uri-secret OW_TP_MMP_TARGET_URI --out docs/tech-partnerships/recon/U2-invoices/live/.
4. TP report: /home/ubuntu/.venvs/recon/bin/python .migration/tools/tp_recon_report.py --unit U2-invoices --mode live --result docs/tech-partnerships/recon/U2-invoices/live/result.json --load-first docs/tech-partnerships/recon/U2-invoices/load-live-previous.json --load-rerun docs/tech-partnerships/recon/U2-invoices/load-live.json, then `make tp-validate-recon FILE=docs/tech-partnerships/recon/U2-invoices.live.recon.json`. Commit harness outputs (redacted), load records and the TP report; run the repo skill .agents/skills/tp-pre-pr-self-check before the PR.

EXPECTED: invoices.lines is a scoped embed (D-012: target_where on both sides, orphans excluded by design), so the harness returns PASS with merge_eligible=false and a scoped-embed warning. That is the approved model, not a failure: report status PASS, merge_eligible=false, and list embed_extras_unchecked under Unverified paths. Any other warning or finding is a real failure.
REPORT write_targets exactly ["ow_tp_mmp_live.invoices", "ow_tp_mmp_live.quarantine_invoice_line"].

CODE (services/legacy-billing/app)
- backends/__init__.py: BILLING_BACKEND=oracle|mongo selects the backend (keep the existing default and the oracle path byte-for-byte in behavior); expose backend_name(). New backends/mongo.py implementing every operation backends/oracle.py exposes (reads and the writes: plan change, usage events, month-end/rating, credit notes, dunning, audit log, sequences), against the spec's collections: customers (attributes array), invoices (embedded lines), billing_invoices, codes, tenants, plans, subscriptions(+_hist), usage_events, rating_*, credit_notes, dunning_attempts, notifications, billing_audit_log, sequences. BILLING_MONGO_URI required in mongo mode; BILLING_MONGO_DB defaults to ow_tp_mmp_live; one module-level MongoClient; multi-document writes in a transaction (with_transaction); money as Decimal128 <-> Decimal, never float; BILLING_READONLY=1 skips the same provisioning/audit writes it skips on Oracle; PyMongo errors map to the same 503 UNAVAILABLE as Oracle errors. facade.py/reports.py: identical route, page and JSON shapes; only the report's source label changes Oracle -> MongoDB. Pin pymongo in requirements.txt.
- Known traps from an earlier attempt: DuplicateKeyError inside with_transaction aborts the whole transaction, so use existence-checked upserts; Oracle renders NUMBER via canonical Decimal, so .normalize() computed Decimals before rendering; issued invoices round the tax half to 2 dp while preview keeps it unrounded.
FIXTURE + CI
- docker-compose.tp.yml: service `mongo-billing-fixture`, image mongo:8.0.32, single-node replica set (transactions), 127.0.0.1 only, seeded from a committed synthetic seed generated from the synthetic Oracle fixture (never live rows). .github/workflows/tp-golden-smoke.yml: a job that starts it, seeds it and runs the Mongo-backend tests, no external services.
- Tests under services/legacy-billing/tests/: differential parity Oracle-fixture backend vs Mongo-fixture backend over every read route (Casey-style customer with a duplicate attribute, a multi-line invoice, the admin report) and each write op (run on a scratch copy; fixture only). Both backends must give identical responses.
LIVE EVIDENCE (read-only; this unit writes nothing to Atlas and never starts the app against the EC2)
- services/legacy-billing/migration/U4-app-backend/ops.live.json: tier-4 ops mirroring the backend's read queries on customers, codes, tenants, plans (loaded in waves 0/1): each {"name","collection","source_sql": literal SELECT on ow_billing.*, "target_pipeline", "rules"}. Run once: recon run --unit U4-app-backend --family oracle --mapping .migration/03_mapping_spec.json --collections codes,tenants,plans --ops services/legacy-billing/migration/U4-app-backend/ops.live.json --tolerances .migration/02_tolerances.json --canonicalization <oracle.md> --mode live --target-class migration_cluster --source-dsn-secret OW_TP_ORACLE_RO_DSN --target-uri-secret OW_TP_MMP_TARGET_URI --target-db ow_tp_mmp_live --allowed-targets-file .migration/allowed_targets.json --source-concurrency 1 --out docs/tech-partnerships/recon/U4-app-backend/live/ (validate on the fixture first with --mode fixture --target-class local).
- Also commit ops.post-wave.json (invoices, billing_invoices, subscriptions, admin report aggregates) for the wave verifier to replay after siblings U2/U3 land; do not run it live yourself (those collections are being reloaded concurrently).
- Run the service's lint and tests. Unverified paths in the PR: everything not covered by live tier-4.
REPORT write_targets exactly ["fixture:mongo-billing-fixture (ow_tp_mmp_live, local CI container; no Atlas writes)"].
